description: Returns every retained version of a slug owned by the token, newest first. Inputs: slug and token. Each entry includes version, created_at, file_count, bytes, kind (publish, merge, or restore), restored_from, and a public permalink. Free keeps 10 versions, Hobby 50, Pro unlimited.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: list_versions
title: List retained versions
